title: Gemma 4 joins the text models
summary:
Gemma 4 joined the model list, generation and app authorization got more predictable, and the community catalog grew by three apps.

Google’s Gemma 4 26B A4B was added as `gemma`, with text and image input, tool use, reasoning, and a 262,144-token context window. Access is limited to paid users.

Self-hosted image requests now pass validated dimensions to the backend without silently scaling smaller images up. Nova Reel’s video generation and finished-video retrieval were repaired for Workers, and Replicate-backed request configuration was corrected.

CatGPT’s consent screen now identifies the app. App lookup and key creation share redirect-matching rules that allow query parameters on registered URLs without a query and tolerate one trailing slash. Denying authorization stays on the page when a redirect cannot be verified.

highlights.title: Gemma 4 joins the models
highlights.text: Use `gemma` with text or image input, tool calls, reasoning, and a 262,144-token context window. Available with paid access. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemma).
